name: THE NIGHT BEFORE THE BLOOD MOON
source:
It is often said that if you love someone, you should let them go.  
A short, crisp 1k words long visual novel about a conversation between you and the... lover...(?) of the person who kidnapped you.

[From [url=https://raazberry.itch.io/the-night-before-the-blood-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人们常说，如果你爱一个人，就应该放手。
一部简短、清晰的1000字长视觉小说，讲述了你和绑架你的人的……情人……（？）之间的对话。

[来自[url=https://raazberry.itch.io/the-night-before-the-blood-moon]itch.io[/url]]
